intro: Nominalstil is the register of administration, law and much academic writing: clauses compressed into noun phrases with genitive and prepositional attributes, the verb reduced to a light verb such as erfolgen, stattfinden or sein. The aim is to do this deliberately and undo it fluently. The twenty sentences here go both ways. In the first twelve you compress: the source clause stands in the cue after the arrow (←), and you supply the decisive nominal part — the noun made from the verb (Auswertung, Zustellung), the genitive that replaces the subject (des Zugausfalls), the adjective that replaces the adverb (seiner schnellen Reaktion), the agent with durch, the preposition phrase that replaces the conjunction (Während der Sanierung), or the light verb itself (erfolgte). In the last eight you unpack: the nominal phrase stands in the cue and you restore the verb, the tense, the adverb or the conjunction. Wherever German offers more than one natural rendering (Protest / Widerstand, erfolgte / geschah, einhält / beachtet / befolgt), every one is accepted. Reading official letters and writing formal reports take exactly these moves.
tips[0].title: Verdichten: five moves, one noun phrase
tips[0].text: verb → noun (beschließen → der Beschluss) · subject → genitive or durch (der Rat → des Rates / durch den Rat) · object → genitive, compound or preposition (das Projekt verschieben → die Verschiebung des Projekts) · conjunction → preposition (weil → wegen, obwohl → trotz, wenn → bei, damit → zu/zur, während → während + Gen) · adverb → adjective (schnell reagieren → die schnelle Reaktion).
tips[0].check.why: The adverb pünktlich becomes an attributive adjective; after der in the genitive feminine it takes the weak ending -en.
tips[0].visual.rows[0].a: nachdem man die Daten ausgewertet hatte
tips[0].visual.rows[1].a: weil die Nachfrage stark gestiegen ist
tips[0].visual.rows[1].b: aufgrund des starken Anstiegs der Nachfrage
tips[1].title: Who does what: genitive, durch, von
tips[1].text: The genitive attribute takes the object of a transitive verb (die Prüfung des Antrags) or the subject of an intransitive one (der Ausfall des Zuges). When the object already fills the genitive slot, the agent goes into durch — or seitens in official prose: die Prüfung des Antrags durch die Kommission. von is used where a genitive cannot be marked, above all with plurals without an article (die Ankunft von Flüchtlingen, die Festnahme von drei Verdächtigen), and with names in speech.
tips[1].trap: Next to a genitive object, an agent with von (die Verschiebung des Projekts vom Rat) is ambiguous and avoided in careful writing — but von is not wrong everywhere: die Befragung von 2000 Haushalten is the only possible form.
tips[1].check.why: A plural without an article cannot show the genitive, so von takes over: die Befragung von 500 Studierenden.
tips[2].title: The light verbs: erfolgen, stattfinden, sein
tips[2].text: A fully nominal sentence keeps one weak verb: Die Zustellung erfolgt binnen zwei Wochen. Die Versammlung findet am Freitag statt. Die Beachtung der Regeln ist Pflicht. erfolgen is for processes carried out by someone (Zahlung, Prüfung, Verlegung); stattfinden for events (Sitzung, Versammlung, Wahl). In the past: erfolgte, fand … statt.
tips[2].trap: erfolgen needs a process noun: ‘Die Sitzung erfolgte am Montag’ is wrong — Die Sitzung fand am Montag statt. Two erfolgen in one paragraph is a sign to unpack one sentence.
tips[2].check.why: A Sitzung is an event, so it takes stattfinden; erfolgen is reserved for processes such as Zahlung or Prüfung.
tips[2].visual.rows[1].b: Das Treffen findet am Montag statt.
tips[3].title: Auflösen: head noun → verb, then tense and conjunction
tips[3].text: Find the head noun and turn it back into a verb (Schließung → schließen). The durch-phrase or genitive agent becomes the subject; the genitive object becomes the object. The preposition becomes a conjunction (nach → nachdem, bei → wenn / falls, wegen → weil, zur → um … zu, trotz → obwohl) and the adjective becomes an adverb. Supply the tense: nach + noun usually needs the pluperfect in the nachdem-clause.
tips[3].check.why: With a past main clause, the earlier action in the nachdem-clause takes the pluperfect, and renovieren forms it with haben.
tips[4].title: Dose it: two genitives, then a compound
tips[4].text: Two genitives in a row are readable; three are not. Break the chain with a compound (die Daten der Befragung → die Befragungsdaten) or a preposition. Nominal style belongs in headings, minutes and notices; in a paragraph of argument, unpack.
tips[4].check.why: The compound Hausvorschriften removes one genitive and leaves two, which is still readable.
remember[0]: Verdichten: verb → noun, subject/object → genitive, agent → durch, conjunction → preposition, adverb → adjective.
remember[1]: Auflösen: head noun → verb, agent → subject, preposition → conjunction, adjective → adverb; supply the tense.
remember[2]: erfolgen for processes, stattfinden for events; two genitives at most.
mistakes[0].why: When the object already stands in the genitive, the agent is expressed with durch (or seitens).
mistakes[1].why: erfolgen goes with processes (Prüfung, Zahlung); events take stattfinden.
mistakes[2].why: When nach + noun is unpacked into a nachdem-clause with a past main clause, the earlier action takes the pluperfect.
mistakes[3].why: Three genitives in a row are unreadable; a compound breaks the chain.
hook: Turn 'nachdem man die Daten ausgewertet hatte' into 'nach Auswertung der Daten' and back: the core move of official and academic German.
recall.today: Both directions at full density, with erfolgen and stattfinden, and how much is too much.
